collection.description: A teenage apprentice believes a familiar craft method wastes material, but their mentor dismisses the suggestion.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (apprentice), a teenage apprentice, believes a familiar craft method wastes material, but their mentor, (mentor), dismisses the suggestion.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (crafts) spots a compromise neither had considered.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (apprentice) hears a different explanation and revises their proposal.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (mentor) admits they dismissed the idea too quickly.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (apprentice) discovers that the old method prevents a problem they had not anticipated.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The delay frustrates (apprentice), who learns how to ask for a specific time to revisit the issue.

a1__fx.name: Outcome A1
a1__fx.text: The new method saves fiber and earns a careful second look.
